facts.claim: The Lodge closed in the third degree and opened in the first degree for ballot.
facts.quote: the Lodge closed in the 3° and opened in the 1° for ballot.

facts.claim: The Lodge decided to vest its funds in Messrs. Palmer & Co., a large banking firm in Hyderabad.
facts.quote: the funds of the Lodge be vested in the hands of Messrs. Palmer & Co., the big banking firm of Hyderabad.

facts.claim: At that time the Lodge had 49 members, 35 of whom were passed Masters.
facts.quote: at the time of the above proposition the Lodge consisted of 49 members, of whom no less than 35 were passed Masters, i.e., had passed the Chair, which was the qualification for the Royal Arch.
